scope: Seven finite North Shore industrial silhouette groups; no site operations or public traversal

Fibreco.height_status: All heights are editable M1 estimates; source confirms six pellet and fifteen grain silos, not their heights

Seaspan.height_status: Owner and lifting contractor state 80m high and76m wide; member proportions and parked location are estimates

VancouverWharves.height_status: Editable M1 estimates; mapped current sheds, tanks and silos only

Richardson.height_status: 2012 operator design report: proposed annex about50m, existing workhouse23m taller and western storage5m lower. 2016 completion confirmed. Exact workhouse subdivision is a photo-informed estimate.

Cargill.height_status: Operator identity and current mapped grain structures; source dimensions not found in bounded research. Both heights and workhouse assignment remain estimates.

Neptune.height_status: Operator confirms two enclosed potash sheds. Heights and coarse gable profile are estimates. B2 replacement state unresolved, so no invented current B2 shiploader.

G3.height_status: CLAC construction account states approximately42.6m silos and81m cleaning facility. Sonic design page states64m including conveyors, a different unresolved envelope. M1 uses42.6m bodies with estimated47m galleries; it does not certify the64m claim.
